{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Count rows with biomarker_baseline == -999
num_neg999 = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()

# Remove rows with biomarker_baseline == -999
data_clean = data[data['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
data_clean = data_clean.sort_values(by='sample_seq', ascending=False)
data_clean = data_clean.drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Correct batch-B values: divide by 10 to convert µg/L to ng/mL
data_clean['biomarker_final_corrected'] = data_clean['biomarker_final']
data_clean.loc[data_clean['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_corrected'] /= 10

# Compute mean of corrected biomarker_final
mean_biomarker_final = data_clean['biomarker_final_corrected'].mean()

# Print the numbers that will be in the evidence
print(num_neg999)
print(len(data_clean))
print((data_clean['assay_batch'] == 'B').sum())
print(mean_biomarker_final)"}
